steps.caption: Social Media
steps.narration: This is Social Media. Write a post once, and send it to every account a business uses.

steps.caption: Open a business
steps.narration: Open this roofing company. ConstructHUB connects its social accounts directly.

steps.caption: Post to
steps.narration: Under Compose, the accounts mapped to it are already ticked.

steps.caption: Choose the accounts
steps.narration: Untick any to skip. This post skips LinkedIn.

steps.value: Fall roof checkups are open in Denver.
steps.caption: Write it once
steps.narration: Type the post once.

steps.caption: A copy per network, with a counter
steps.narration: Each network gets its own copy to tweak, with a character counter.

steps.caption: Add a photo
steps.narration: Instagram needs a photo, so paste a public link to one.

steps.caption: Your media library
steps.narration: Or attach a saved photo from the media library.

steps.caption: Post now, schedule, or save a draft
steps.narration: Then post now, set a schedule time, or save it as a draft.

steps.caption: Save draft
steps.narration: Choose Save draft. It lands in Calendar and queue.

steps.caption: One draft per account
steps.narration: Each account gets its own draft, at the top of the list.

steps.value: Attic too hot? Ridge vents can help.
steps.caption: Edit a draft
steps.narration: Edit a draft, like this AI draft, right here.

steps.caption: Save edit
steps.narration: Save edit keeps it a draft until you approve it.

steps.caption: Auto mode
steps.narration: Auto mode drafts posts for you, in the mix you choose.

steps.caption: Approval queue by default
steps.narration: Drafts wait for your approval, unless you choose fully automatic.

steps.caption: Generate a draft
steps.narration: Or generate a draft now from these settings.

steps.caption: All-clients calendar
steps.narration: Running several businesses? The All-clients calendar lists all their posts.

steps.caption: Filter by network
steps.narration: Filter it by status or network.

steps.caption: Each row names its business
steps.narration: Each row names its business.

steps.caption: Menu: Social Media
steps.narration: You'll find Social Media in the left menu, under Tools.

youtube.title: Social Media in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short tour of Social Media in ConstructHUB: pick a business, write a post once with a copy and character counter per network, check the calendar and queue, edit an AI draft, see auto mode's approval queue, and view every client's posts on one calendar. ConstructHUB connects your social accounts directly and posts for you.
